QuestInfo.name: For the Queen
QuestInfo.0: You gave Jasmin's silk to Tigun to give to Queen Areda. Go tell Jasmine that you have delivered the silk.
QuestInfo.1: Jasmin asks you to get her something that she can offer to Queen Areda. She believes #r#t04000941##k would be perfect since the queen likes fancy things. She also tells you that you should give #r#t04000942##k to Tigun as a bribe. \r\n\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You got the item to offer the queen to get Jasmin's son a job. But is it right?

0.0: Wait, are you saying you gave the silk to Tigun? That greedy creep! I should have warned you... What do we do now that our only wealth is gone?
0.1: I know this might be asking too much, but I need a new gift for the Queen. I just can't watch my son live like that anymore!

yes.0: The Queen likes luxury. Ten #r#t04000941##k items would make her give Aldin a job for sure! Also give 10 #r#t04000942##k items to Tigun, so he'll let you enter the castle.

no.0: Don't make me do this... You caused this mess!

npc.0: Please, find #r10 #t04000941##k and #r10 #t04000942##k items! I'm so worried about my son's career.
